text:
Maya (PM): quick post-launch huddle notes — consolidating follow-on work and deciding what goes into the immediate hotfix lane vs next sprint. Three items: misplaced search results after the rollout, streaming start latency on Android, and intermittent SDK upload failures for very large attachments.
Ishaan: can you summarize severity?
Maya (PM): search: several enterprise customers reported wrong top results after we switched reranker; visible impact on revenue signals. Android: initial token delay of ~300-600ms on flaky networks. SDK: uploads failing with 413 on multipart boundary for >200MB files, rare but reproducible.
Chloe: reranker issue sounds like correctness -> must-fix. We should block further reranker rollouts and prepare a revert.
Ravi: infra note: the multipart failures look like our gateway trimming headers on long boundaries when chunked encoding is present. I have a workaround rule we can flip in the ingress to accept larger boundaries.
Ishaan: proposal: must-fix = reranker revert + urgent = Android streaming mitigation (client buffer + server heartbeat) + P3 = multipart gateway rule (temporary ingress flip now, cleanup next sprint).
Maya (PM): acceptance criteria:
- Reranker: rollback applied OR score normalization fix merged; customer test set top-1 relevance >= baseline on 95% of queries.
- Android streaming: client SDK patch deployed with 150ms buffered-first-chunk + server keepalive; telemetry shows 40% drop in start-gap within 72h.
- Uploads: ingress rule enabled and validated; no new 413s for 48h. Permanent fix scheduled next sprint.
Chloe: I'll open the revert PR and include a small smoke test harness (5 queries from customer corpus) in PR body.
Ravi: enabling ingress rule now for pool-4 can be done immediately. I'll notify infra and support.
Ishaan: I'll own Android SDK patch, target shipping a canary to beta users by EOD. Also will add a flag `--defer-first-chunk` for quick rollback.
infra-bot: ingress toggle applied to pool-4 at 2026-03-23T02:30:00Z by Ravi. Monitoring for 48h.
Maya (PM): timeline: reranker must be validated in 24h. If not fixed we'll offer routing to hosted API + credit.
Chloe: PR submitted, linking canary results once available.
Ravi: heaptraces for multipart failures uploaded to gs://rwd-infra/artifacts/1767733333/
Ishaan: SDK canary uploaded to beta channel; will post telemetry link.
Maya (PM): moving reranker + android streaming into "hotfix lane" on roadmap board. Upload ingress into hotfix for immediate mitigation but mark for cleanup next sprint.
Chloe: owners: reranker = Chloe + Ishaan; android streaming = Ishaan; uploads = Ravi.
Maya (PM): follow-up sync tomorrow 09:00 PT or earlier if canary/rollback shows problems. Thanks team.
